summary: Magna International Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders held May 4, 2026. 79.21% of shares were represented. All 12 director nominees were elected, Deloitte reappointed as auditor, and the Say on Pay resolution passed with 89.66% support. Board committee chairs were confirmed, including new appointments following retirement of a director after 12 years. The filing is a routine disclosure of annual meeting voting outcomes and board committee assignments, not a special situation event such as a governance fight or forced departure. This is a standard post-meeting filing with no unusual or activist-driven items.
